test_name: Integrate Code Repository with Token Verification
description: Test the process of integrating a code repository by selecting repository type and verifying Github token.
steps: Navigate to the RoostGPT Config page using the 'RoostGPT Config' link.
Select the radio button for 'Enterprise' repository type using the test ID '[data-testid="server-git-type-radio-button"]'.
Enter Github token in the input field '[data-testid="github-source-token"]'.
Click on the 'Verify Token' button using the selector '[data-testid="github-source-token-unMask-icon"]'.
Observe the token verification status displayed on the page.
expected_results: Repository type selection is applied correctly.
Integration status is displayed on the page.
edge_cases: Token verification fails due to API downtime.
Radio button selection is not applied.
Token input field does not accept special characters.
User is unable to navigate the page using keyboard.
data_requirements: API endpoint for token verification must be functional.
Test suite configuration must already exist.
dependencies: Github API key must be active.
RoostGPT Config page must be accessible.
User must be logged in with appropriate permissions.
performance_metrics: Page load time for RoostGPT Config.
Latency in applying repository type options.
accessibility_requirements: Input fields must have ARIA labels.
Radio button group must be accessible via keyboard.
Verification button must have accessible labels.
